description: The great-circle distance between two points in km and miles, the initial bearing and the midpoint. Each point is a lat,lon pair or a place name (geocoded with OpenStreetMap data, ODbL). Straight-line distance only, not a route. Price: $0.001 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
